description: Election Commission - A. M. Fahmiya was selected as the member of the Kattankudy Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
